career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors (SIs) in Punjab Police are appointed across District Police, Armed Police, and Investigation Cadres under the Punjab Police Act, 2007, the Punjab Police (Cadre and Recruitment) Rules, and the Punjab Police Rules, 1934. Sub-Inspectors are directly gazette-tracked officers who can rise through departmental promotion to Inspector, Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) in the Punjab Police Service (PPS), and subsequently earn induction into the Indian Police Service (IPS, Punjab Cadre) under Central DoPT regulations.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process consists of three sequential stages: Stage I (Computer Based Test comprising Paper I, Paper II, and mandatory qualifying Paper III Punjabi), Stage II (Physical Screening Test and Physical Measurement Test), and Stage III (Document Scrutiny). Final merit ranking is calculated on the aggregate marks scored in Paper I and Paper II (out of 800 marks) among candidates who qualify Paper III (Punjabi), PST, PMT, and DV.

stages.source_label: Punjab Police Recruitment Notification (Sub-Inspectors in District, Armed & Investigation Cadres) — Scheme of Examination

papers.negative_marking: -25% (1 mark deducted per incorrect answer; 4 marks per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% aggregate in Paper I & II combined (35% for SC/ST/BC/EWS)

papers.paper_name: Paper II (Logical & Analytical Reasoning 50 Qs, Digital Literacy & Computer Awareness 30 Qs, English Language 20 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: -25% (1 mark deducted per incorrect answer; 4 marks per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% aggregate in Paper I & II combined (35% for SC/ST/BC/EWS)

papers.paper_name: Paper III (Mandatory Qualifying Punjabi Language Paper equivalent to Matriculation standard)

financial_package.note: Compensation for Sub-Inspectors in Punjab Police is governed by the Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2021 notified by the Department of Finance, Government of Punjab. Sub-Inspectors enter at Punjab Pay Matrix Level 6 with an entry basic pay of ₹35,400. In accordance with Government of Punjab Department of Finance policy instructions (Letters No. 7/204/2012-4FP1/60 dated 15.01.2015 and No. 7/42/2020-5FP1/741-746 dated 17.07.2020), newly recruited personnel receive fixed minimum basic pay without allowances during the initial 3-year probation period, after which regular allowances (DA, HRA, uniform allowance, investigation allowance, medical allowance) are admissible in full.
financial_package.pay_level: Punjab Pay Matrix Level 6 (Entry Basic ₹35,400; Scale ₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Punjab Police Sub-Inspector Advt. No. 01/2023 & Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2021, Department of Finance, Government of Punjab
financial_package.estimate_note: Post-probation gross salary is computed from Punjab Pay Matrix Level 6 entry basic ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + Punjab HRA (ranging from 8% in rural police stations to 16% in major cities like SAS Nagar/Mohali, Ludhiana, Amritsar: ₹2,832 to ₹5,664) + fixed medical allowance (₹1,000) + special police investigation allowance and kit maintenance. Net in-hand estimate reflects statutory deductions including 10% NPS contribution (Basic + DA = ₹5,593), Punjab Development Tax (₹200/month), and GIS (₹200). Note: Newly appointed officers receive fixed basic pay ₹35,400 during the initial probation period as per Punjab government policy instructions.
official_perks: Government-allotted residential family quarters in police lines or sub-divisional police headquarters (subject to availability)
Official wireless-fitted police patrol vehicle / motorcycle and monthly official POL (fuel) quota for operational duties
Special Investigation Allowance and uniform kit maintenance allowance under Punjab Police Rules
Free comprehensive medical treatment for officer and dependent family members under Punjab Government Medical Attendance Rules
Contributory pension coverage under the National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution by Government of Punjab
Official service weapon (Glock 9mm / 9mm Pistol / Service Revolver) entitlement for law enforcement duties
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and 30 days annual earned leave entitlement plus casual leave
